markets.rules_primary: If DEN Broncos D/ST scores the first touchdown in Denver vs Arizona Pro Football game originally scheduled for Oct 25, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The following market refers to DEN Broncos D/ST in the Denver vs Arizona professional football game originally scheduled for Oct 25, 2026. If DEN Broncos D/ST is active but never takes a snap, the market settles to the fair market price before game start. Once DEN Broncos D/ST takes at least one snap, even if nullified by penalty, the market settles based on touchdowns scored. If no touchdowns are scored in the game, the No Touchdown market resolves to Yes and all other player markets resolve to No. Touchdowns scored on fake punts or field goals by the offensive team do not count as a special teams touchdown.
